review_method: Read the source formulation and check applicability of the cited replacement theorem. Novelty is not certified.

records.title: Shortest Descending Paths through Given Faces
records.scope: A prescribed face sequence crossing k edges; arithmetic/oracle model.
records.updated_bound: Expected O~(k log(R/r) log(R/(r delta))) for additive delta ||c||_2 R; nearly linear when radius/accuracy scale factors are controlled.
records.reason: Duplicate segment endpoint variables into constant-dimensional convex blocks and glue neighbors. The generalized dual graph is a path. Forced heights can be eliminated in linear time.

records.title: Touring Convex Bodies - A Conic Programming Solution
records.scope: The base ordered tour through k line segments in fixed dimension, without optional global constraints.
records.old_bound: O(k^3.5 log(1/epsilon)) in the line-segment specialization
records.updated_bound: Expected O~(k log(R/r) log(R/(r delta))) for additive delta ||c||_2 R.
records.reason: Parameterize each segment by one scalar. The same local norm blocks and adjacent equality constraints form a path; there are no height inequalities. Choose midpoint parameters and positive epigraph slack.
records.limitations: Does not claim this bound for arbitrary dimension, unbounded description complexity, nonconvex regions, or optional constraints coupling nonadjacent tour vertices. Conditioning is retained.

records.title: A Simple Streaming Algorithm for Minimum Enclosing Balls
records.reason: The linear-programming hit is in a reference. The main algorithm is a streaming geometric approximation; swapping a dense optimizer does not automatically improve its bound.

records.title: Approximate Shortest Descent Path on a Terrain
records.reason: The introduction cites the fixed-face convex-optimization result, but its own algorithms use Steiner-point discretization and graph search. The new fixed-face bound does not automatically replace its global terrain bound.
